newsitem.title: USA: Sovereign amends timing of stock split.
newsitem.headline: Sovereign amends timing of stock split.

text.p: Sovereign Bancorp Inc, parent company of Sovereign Bank, said Thursday its board of directors amended the timing of the six-for-five stock split of its common stock.
"This change is being made to alleviate shareholder confusion concerning the dates of the stock split, which was declared on January 16," it said.
The company said it will distribute the additional shares on March 14 rather than February 14 to shareholders of record on March 3.
"This will not affect the 15 percent increase in the cash dividend payable on February 14, 1997 to common stock shareholders of record as of January 29, 1997," it said.
